customer_reply:
Hi Quinn,

Thank you for contacting support. I understand you are receiving a 500 Internal Server Error when establishing the Snowflake connector in DataBridge Pro.

To troubleshoot this OAuth exchange failure, please verify the following:

1. Snowflake Role Privileges – Confirm the role has USAGE permissions on database/schema and SELECT on the target tables.
2. Network Policies – If an IP allowlist is enforced in Snowflake, verify that our platform egress IP ranges are included.
3. Redirect URI – Ensure the redirect URI registered in your Snowflake OAuth security integration exactly matches our connector callback URL.
4. Configuration Snapshot – If possible, provide a screenshot of the connector settings page (with credentials obscured).

With these details, we will assist you in completing the integration setup.

Best regards,
Integrations Support
